# Shop code/descriptors and banner reference output

[Hybrid tests](../README.md) · [Proto inputs](../proto/README.md)

`shop.v1.rs` and `shop.binpb` are paired generated outputs used by the common
shop service. The Rust file supplies tonic messages/services; the descriptor
set supplies reflection, validation rules, HTTP/resource annotations, and
message-level middleware decoding.

```bash
cargo test -p tpp-grpc --test fixtures_regen -- --ignored
cargo test -p tpp-grpc --test errors --test intercept --test validation_last
```

Run regeneration only after editing the proto inputs, with `protoc` on PATH.
The regeneration target also discards generated import-only modules. Review
Rust and descriptor changes as one contract update.

`figure_golden.txt` and `table_golden.txt` are captured Go banner output, not
outputs regenerated by the shop compiler. Their tests compare byte-for-byte
layout and display widths:

```bash
cargo test -p tpp-grpc --test banner_figure --test banner_table
```

Refresh these references only from the corresponding Go renderer when the
intended cross-runtime banner contract changes; local output alone is not a
new independent reference.
